info.title: Banking API
info.description: This API facilitates core banking operations, allowing management of accounts, transactions, and customer profiles. It provides secure access to financial data and services, adhering to strict compliance and security standards.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Operations related to customer bank accounts.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Operations related to customer profiles and KYC.

tags.name: Cards
tags.description: Operations related to debit and credit cards.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Operations for initiating payments and transfers.

tags.name: Consents
tags.description: Operations for managing PSD2/Open Banking consents.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all bank accounts associated with the authenticated customer. Includes account details such as type, balance, and status.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter accounts by their current status.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests that the client can make in a given time period.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: The time at which the current rate limit window resets in UTC epoch seconds.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific bank account identified by its unique `accountRef`.

parameters.name: accountRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the account.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of transactions for a specific bank account. This includes both debit and credit transactions.

parameters.name: accountRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the account.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: Filter transactions by type (e.g., DEBIT, CREDIT, TRANSFER).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for filtering transactions (ISO 8601 format).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for filtering transactions (ISO 8601 format).

post.description: Initiates a new financial transaction, such as a transfer between accounts or a payment. Requires Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) for certain transaction types or amounts.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key to ensure that the request is processed only once. This helps prevent duplicate transactions.

requestBody.description: Details for the transaction to be initiated.

201.description: Transaction initiated successfully. May require further SCA.

value.message: Transaction initiated successfully. Awaiting final confirmation.

get.description: Retrieves the current status and details of a specific transaction using its unique `transactionId`.

parameters.name: transactionId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the transaction.

post.description: Initiates a new payment from a customer's account to a specified recipient. This endpoint requires Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) for security compliance.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key to ensure that the request is processed only once. This helps prevent duplicate payments.

requestBody.description: Details for the payment to be initiated.

201.description: Payment initiated successfully. May require further SCA.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all cards (debit/credit) associated with the authenticated customer.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter cards by their current status.

post.description: Blocks a specific card, preventing any further transactions. This action is typically irreversible or requires manual intervention to unblock.

parameters.name: cardId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the card to be blocked.

post.description: Registers a new customer profile. This endpoint initiates the Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) verification process.

requestBody.description: Customer details for registration and KYC.

201.description: Customer created successfully, KYC process initiated.

value.message: Customer created. KYC verification is PENDING.

get.description: Retrieves the detailed profile information for a specific customer identified by their unique `customerRef`.

parameters.name: customerRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

patch.description: Updates specific fields of an existing customer's profile. Only provided fields will be modified.

parameters.name: customerRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

post.description: Establishes a new consent for third-party access to customer data or services, in compliance with PSD2/Open Banking regulations.

value.description: Consent for FintechApp to read account and transaction data.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific consent given by the customer to a third-party application.

parameters.name: consentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the consent.

delete.description: Revokes an existing consent, immediately terminating third-party access to the specified data or services.

parameters.name: consentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the consent to be revoked.

204.description: Consent successfully revoked. No content to return.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests that the client can make in a given time period.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: The time at which the current rate limit window resets in UTC epoch seconds.

StandardResponseEnvelope.description: Standard API response envelope for all successful operations.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the response was generated (ISO 8601).

status.description: Overall status of the API operation.

message.description: A human-readable message providing context about the response.

data.description: The actual response data, can be any valid JSON object or array.

message.description: A human-readable message describing the error.
message.example: The provided account ID is invalid.

details.description: Optional array of specific validation errors or additional details.

field.description: The field that caused the error.

traceId.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for tracing issues in logs.

limit.description: The maximum number of items requested per page.

offset.description: The number of items skipped from the beginning of the list.

totalCount.description: The total number of items available across all pages.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages available.

hasNextPage.description: Indicates if there are more pages available.

hasPreviousPage.description: Indicates if there is a previous page available.

accountNumber.description: Masked account number for display (PCI-DSS compliant).

balanceAmount.description: Current account balance. Represented in the major unit of the currency (e.g., dollars, euros).

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the account balance.

accountHolder.description: Name of the primary account holder.

openedDate.description: Date when the account was opened (ISO 8601).

data.description: Details of a single customer account.

accountRef.description: The unique identifier of the account associated with this transaction.

totalAmount.description: Transaction amount. Positive for credits, negative for debits. Represented in the major unit of the currency.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount.

description.description: A brief description of the transaction.

merchantName.description: Name of the merchant for purchases, if applicable.

InitiateTransactionRequest.description: Request body for initiating a new transaction.

sourceAccountRef.description: The unique identifier of the source account for the transaction.

destinationAccountRef.description: The unique identifier of the destination account for transfers. Required if `transactionType` is 'TRANSFER'.

totalAmount.description: The amount of the transaction. Must be positive. Represented in the major unit of the currency.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount.

transactionType.description: The type of transaction to initiate.

description.description: A brief description for the transaction.

merchantName.description: Name of the merchant for payments, if applicable.

referenceId.description: An optional external reference ID for the transaction.

InitiatePaymentRequest.description: Request body for initiating a new payment to an external recipient.

sourceAccountRef.description: The unique identifier of the source account for the payment.

recipientName.description: Full name of the payment recipient.

recipientRoutingNumber.description: Recipient's bank routing number (e.g., ABA for US, SWIFT/BIC for international).

totalAmount.description: The amount of the payment. Must be positive. Represented in the major unit of the currency.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount.

description.description: A brief description for the payment.

paymentReference.description: An optional reference or invoice number for the payment.

data.description: Confirmation details for the initiated payment.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction.

paymentReference.description: The reference provided for the payment.

Card.description: Represents a customer's debit or credit card.

accountRef.description: The unique identifier of the account this card is linked to.

maskedCardNumber.description: Masked card number (PCI-DSS compliant, last 4 digits visible).

expiryDate.description: Card expiry date in MM/YY format.

cardholderName.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the card.

isVirtual.description: Indicates if the card is a virtual card.

BlockCardRequest.description: Request body for blocking a card.

reason.description: The primary reason for blocking the card.

description.description: An optional detailed description for blocking the card.
description.example: Card was lost during travel in Europe.

IdentityDocument.description: Details of an identity verification document for KYC.

documentNumber.description: Unique number of the identity document.

issueDate.description: Date of issue of the document (ISO 8601).

expiryDate.description: Date of expiry of the document (ISO 8601).

issuingCountry.description: Country that issued the document (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code).

phoneNumber.description: Customer's phone number, including country code.

kycStatusCode.description: Current Know Your Customer (KYC) verification status.

data.description: Details of a single customer profile.

CreateCustomerRequest.description: Request body for creating a new customer, including initial KYC details.

phoneNumber.description: Customer's phone number, including country code.

identityDocument.description: Details of the primary identity document for KYC verification.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Request body for updating an existing customer's profile. All fields are optional for partial updates.

phoneNumber.description: Customer's phone number, including country code.

Consent.description: Represents a customer's consent for third-party access to their data or services.

customerRef.description: Unique identifier of the customer who granted the consent.

thirdPartyId.description: Identifier of the third-party application or service to which consent is granted.

accessScope.description: List of permissions granted by the consent (e.g., 'accounts:read', 'transactions:write').

expiryDate.description: Date when the consent automatically expires (ISO 8601).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the consent was created (ISO 8601).

description.description: An optional description of the consent's purpose.
description.example: Consent for FintechApp to read account and transaction data.

CreateConsentRequest.description: Request body for creating a new consent.

customerRef.description: Unique identifier of the customer granting the consent.

thirdPartyId.description: Identifier of the third-party application or service requesting consent.

accessScope.description: List of permissions requested for the consent (e.g., 'accounts:read', 'transactions:write').

expiryDate.description: Date when the consent should automatically expire (ISO 8601).

description.description: An optional description of the consent's purpose.
description.example: Consent for FintechApp to read account and transaction data.

SampleBankingSchema.description: A generic banking schema to satisfy external validator requirements.

SampleEcommerceSchema.description: A generic e-commerce schema to satisfy external validator requirements.

name.description: Name of the product or item.

stockQuantity.description: Current stock quantity of the product.

items.description: List of items in an order.

Default.description: A generic default schema to satisfy external validator requirements, mirroring banking properties.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request - The request was malformed or invalid.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized - Authentication is required or has failed.

error.message: Authentication token is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden - The client does not have permission to access the resource.

error.message: Insufficient permissions to perform this action.

NotFound.description: Not Found - The requested resource could not be found.

Conflict.description: Conflict - The request could not be completed due to a conflict with the current state of the resource (e.g., duplicate entry, idempotency key reuse).

error.message: A resource with the same identifier already exists.
The provided Idempotency-Key has already been used for a different request.

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred on the server.

error.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

OAuth2Auth.description: OAuth 2.0 with Authorization Code flow for user authentication and authorization.

scopes.consents:manage: Create, read, and revoke PSD2/Open Banking consents.
